expiry_file_window_observation.interpretation: The option file begins roughly one weekly cycle before its own expiry. Therefore H2/H3 far-expiry contracts are not present on the near-week entry dates needed by the strategy.

conclusion: H2/H3 cannot be inferred from this Hugging Face source. The zero H2/H3 opportunity counts are a source-coverage diagnostic, not evidence that exchange-listed far weekly contracts did not exist.
